setup: In an empty folder, copy evals/fixtures/messy-skill.md to pdf-helper/SKILL.md and run the query from that folder
query: Hey, I want you to review the skill pdf-helper. Please make sure we are using best practices and that the skill is optimized from the guidelines of writing-for-agents. Report the findings without editing files.
expected_behavior: Runs the skill validator on pdf-helper, not on writing-for-agents
Groups the findings by BP ID with a count per BP, and ends with a Pass line so every BP appears once
Reports BP_13: the name PDF_Helper breaks the format and does not match the folder pdf-helper
Reports BP_14: the description says what the skill is, not when to load it
Reports BP_07 for the before/after August 2025 instructions and BP_12 for the backslash path and the missing advanced.md

Reports at least two findings the validator cannot catch: BP_19 for 'Claude should', BP_06 for 'Be thorough', BP_03 for field, box, and element, BP_05 for 'Don't forget', or BP_18 for the pdf library with no install step
Gives each finding a file:line and a concrete fix, and edits no file

query: Create a skill that converts a CSV file into a Markdown table. Put it in a folder named after the skill.
expected_behavior: Writes three evaluation scenarios and records a baseline for each before writing the instructions
Names the skill with lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, matching its folder, such as converting-csv-to-markdown
Writes a description that says when to load the skill
Ships a script that does the conversion and tells the agent to run it
Names the tool the script needs, with its install command, before the first step that uses it
Runs the skill validator on the new skill and ends with it printing nothing

setup: In an empty folder, copy evals/fixtures/agents-md.md to AGENTS.md and run the query from that folder
query: Add a rule to AGENTS.md: never commit without running the checks first.
expected_behavior: Merges the rule with the existing just check line instead of adding a second line about the same checks
Phrases the rule positively, such as 'Run just check before every commit and push'
Does not run the skill validator and adds no frontmatter
Leaves the unrelated release rule unchanged
